answer: Identity in this economy is minted at dawn, never bought in bulk: every newcomer must complete a distinct proof-of-work task and lock a refundable stake that only unlocks after it has paid a small ember of fees across many epochs. Registering a thousand puppets therefore demands a thousand separate stakes and a thousand streams of real fee-payment, so the terrace of viable identities an attacker can afford stays narrow and each fake agent costs as much as an honest one. A cluster that cannot fund its own fees starves, and its stake is forfeited.
